armor.defensiveActiveBuffChoiceBody: Your Buff gives you more Armor.

defaultActiveBuffPreview.name: Active Buff: Armor
defaultActiveBuffPreview.fluff: You reinforce your body, armor, stance, magic, skin, or guard with a temporary defensive layer.

buffs.label: Spell Resistance

buffs.label: Armor Aura
buffs.explanation: Share Armor with nearby allies.

buffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

buffs.label: Summon Damage Aura
buffs.explanation: Your summons deal extra damage while inside your bonded aura.

buffs.label: Summon Armor Aura
buffs.explanation: Your summons gain Armor while inside your bonded aura.

buffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

buffs.label: Absorption Stone Increase

buffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

buffs.label: Parry Recovery
buffs.explanation: Requires Parry Passive — regain spent Parry up to a per-round cap.

buffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

buffs.label: Damage Negation Pool
buffs.explanation: Requires slotted Damage Negation Passive — temporary DN pool refreshed each Preparation.

buffs.durationNote: Duration: Mastery Rank complete Rounds. In combat, activate during Preparation (commits base Attack Action).

passives.label: Damage
passives.hint: Extra Damage on all damage rolls you make.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +2d8 Damage on all damage rolls you make.

passives.label: Armor Reduction
passives.hint: Your strikes ignore a slice of the Armor that would otherwise blunt them — without changing the target's listed Armor.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — On each eligible damaging Attack or damaging Spell you make, ignore 5 Armor counted against that attack only (same curve as Passive: Armor). Does not lower listed Armor, does not help allies, does not apply Corrode/Expose, and does not change Attack TN, Casting TN, or Raises. Combines with legal Corrode, Might Stone Armor Reduction, and Weapon Penetration(X); effective Armor never below 0.

passives.label: Critical
passives.hint: Free Critical(1) roll designations each Combat — separate from Active Buff Critical and Agility Stone Crit.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 free Critical(1) roll for this Combat. Before one eligible Martial Attack Roll or damaging Spell Casting Roll, spend one charge to designate that complete roll as Critical(1): natural 7s and 8s explode in the Attack/Casting Pool. Not a Damage Die bonus. A miss still spends the charge. One shared AoE roll costs one charge. Does not require Agility Stone Crit or Active Buff: Critical. Choose exactly one Critical source per roll.

passives.label: Maximization
passives.hint: Free Maximization uses each Combat for Damage or Healing Rolls — separate from Vitality Stone Maximization.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 free Maximization use shared between complete Damage Rolls and Healing Rolls this Combat. Declare immediately before an eligible Damage or Healing Roll (after Damage Negation for damage). Remaining d8s become artificial 8s — not natural 8s. A miss with no Damage Roll does not spend a use. One shared AoE Damage Roll costs one use. Does not require Vitality Stone Maximization. Choose exactly one Maximization source per roll.

passives.label: Special Aura
passives.hint: Choose one eligible diminishing Special(X). Inside your aura, it bites a little deeper.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — While a creature inside your 2 m aura is already affected by your chosen eligible Special(X), increase that Special by +1 step. This aura never applies, refreshes, extends, spreads, or triggers the Special.

passives.label: Enemy Evade Reduction
passives.hint: Your Martial Attack Rolls treat the targeted enemy as slightly easier to hit. Only your attacks; never changes their stored Evade.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Against your own eligible Martial Attack Rolls (including Martial AoE targets and Martial Reaction attacks that use a Martial Attack Roll), reduce the target's effective Evade by 2 (minimum 0). Does not modify stored Evade, create Expose, add Attack Dice, or change Spell Final TN.

passives.label: Spell Resistance Piercing
passives.hint: Your Spells ignore a slice of the target's Spell Resistance. Shared Casting Rolls still use per-target Final Spell TN.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — When you cast a Spell, ignore 2 of each target's Spell Resistance against that Spell (remaining SR = max(0, target SR − piercing)). Final Spell TN = Spell Base TN + remaining SR. Does not reduce Spell Base TN, stored SR, Evade, or SR against other casters. AoE Spells keep one Casting Roll with per-target Final TN.

passives.label: Special Amplification
passives.hint: Increases eligible numeric Special(X) values you successfully deliver with your own Martial/Spell Attacks. Distinct from Special Aura.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — When your qualifying successful Martial or Spell Attack delivers an eligible numeric Special(X), increase that Special by +1 after printed X, successful Raise Special Increase and Intellect Stone Special Boost, and before target Vulnerability, Special Negation and the 4 × MR application limit. Does not create Specials, amplify aura ticks, ongoing damage, ally/Summon attacks, binary Specials or hard control.

passives.label: Evade
passives.hint: Permanent Evade.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +4 Evade.

passives.label: Damage Reduction
passives.hint: Percentage reduction on incoming damage.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain 10% Damage Reduction.

passives.label: Health
passives.hint: Extra Health Bars.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +1 Wounded Health Bar and +1 Injured Health Bar.

passives.label: Fortitude
passives.hint: Fortitude enlarges each normal Health Bar. It does not add bars, heal, or reopen Scarred bars. Cannot be slotted with Passive: Health.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Each normal Health Bar holds Vitality × 5 while this Passive is slotted.

passives.label: Regeneration
passives.hint: Restore Scarred Health Bars on yourself a few times per Tyhran Day (full HP each).
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Restore up to 2 Scarred Health Bars on yourself per Tyhran Day (full HP). Activate when able; does not spend Attack or Reaction. No turn-start healing.

passives.label: Phasing
passives.hint: Ignore a limited number of hits each combat.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 Phasing charge. Each charge lets you ignore one hit against you.

passives.label: Spell Resistance
passives.hint: Your body, mind, soul, or warding pattern rejects hostile spell structure.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +5 Spell Resistance.

passives.label: Special Negation
passives.hint: Whenever an eligible hostile Special(X) would be applied, reduce its value by Special Negation before it is applied.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Reduce every incoming eligible hostile Special by 4.

passives.label: Invisibility
passives.hint: Always on: harder to locate/target (Perception TN + bonus), not higher Evade. Blocks Normal Awareness; higher ranks also block chosen Special Senses. AoE still hits.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Always on. Gain +4 Invisibility Bonus (Power Level). Obscures Normal Combat Awareness (and Darkvision) and 1 chosen Special Combat Sense. Perception TN = (4 × MR) + 4 − (Lost Health Bars × MR) + Stealth Spent. Uncovered Special Combat Senses perceive you normally (no Invisibility TN). Attacking does not interrupt Invisibility; observers use normal Perception to locate and target you. Ordinary Stealth hiding ends when attacking. Incapacitated suppresses Invisibility until you recover.

passives.label: Parry
passives.hint: Spend a Parry pool to strip Attack Dice before they roll.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Entering Parry spends the base Attack Action. Extra Attacks remain. Maximum Parry Pool 10 (chosen Parry Attribute, limited by ceil(5 × Level / 2)). Martial (Might or Agility) removes Attack Dice; 0 dice = Fully Parried. Spell (Intellect, Resolve, or Influence) removes Casting Dice from a direct Spell whose origin is within 22 m; 0 dice = Fully Countered.

passives.label: Damage Negation
passives.hint: Spend a combat reserve of Damage Dice before damage is rolled.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Combat reserve 8 Damage Dice (2 × Power Level). Spend 1:1 to remove Damage Dice after a hit is established but before they are rolled. Shared across the Combat; does not refresh each Round. Nominal catalogue cost 10 PP per removed Die; purchase is still 20 PP per PL. Does not alter the hit, Specials, flat damage, or on-hit effects. Distinct from Vitality Stone Ability: Damage Negation (temporary).

passives.label: Temporary HP
passives.hint: Temporary HP at the start of combat, before real Health.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — While slotted, at Combat start (before any legal combat damage), gain 20 Temporary HP (5 × Power Level). The pool remains until depleted or Combat end. Does not heal real HP, restore Scarred Bars, or trigger Absorption. Distinct from Active Buff / Stone / Reaction Temporary HP sources.

passives.label: Self Cleanse
passives.hint: At the start of each of your Turns, after Tick, Natural Special Recovery and Diminishing Decay, cleanse yourself once more.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of each of your Turns — after Special Ticks, Natural Special Recovery and Diminishing Decay, and before Persistent Zone start-of-Turn applications — gain an additional Cleanse(2) on yourself. Freely distribute among eligible negative Specials (including Cleanse-eligible Root). Does not replace Natural Special Recovery, heal HP, cost an Action, or cleanse non-eligible effects.

passives.label: Telepathy
passives.hint: You open silent Mind Links and grant Telepathic Access for Mental Powers.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Range: 32 m. Links: 2 willing creatures. Simple meaning, emotion, direction, and intent no longer require a shared spoken language. Grants Telepathic Access; Mental Active level is capped by this Passive.

passives.label: Initiative
passives.hint: You enter combat already moving through possibilities that others have not yet recognized.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +8 Initiative.

passives.label: Summon Tokens
passives.hint: Extra Summon Tokens for bonds you already unlocked — never new summons from nothing.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +8 Summon Tokens for existing bonds only.

passives.label: Absorption
passives.hint: Scarred Health Bars from hostile damage become Temporary Colorless Stones. No extra HP.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — 2 Temporary Colorless Stones per Scarred Health Bar (max 4 triggers per combat). Stones arrive Ready at the next Preparation Phase and expire at combat end. No extra HP.

passives.label: Speed
passives.hint: Your normal Speed statistic increases. Dash doubles the increased Speed.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Increase your normal Speed by +4 m. Applied once to the Speed statistic (not as a separate per-Movement-Action bonus). Dash doubles the increased Speed. Stone Movement Enhancement is added once after the Movement Action distance (including Dash). Slow, Root, Immovable and other restrictions apply normally; minimum effective Speed 0.

passives.label: Damage
passives.hint: Extra Damage on all damage rolls you make.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +2d8 Damage on all damage rolls you make.

passives.label: Armor Reduction
passives.hint: Your strikes ignore a slice of the Armor that would otherwise blunt them — without changing the target's listed Armor.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — On each eligible damaging Attack or damaging Spell you make, ignore 5 Armor counted against that attack only (same curve as Passive: Armor). Does not lower listed Armor, does not help allies, does not apply Corrode/Expose, and does not change Attack TN, Casting TN, or Raises. Combines with legal Corrode, Might Stone Armor Reduction, and Weapon Penetration(X); effective Armor never below 0.

passives.label: Critical
passives.hint: Free Critical(1) roll designations each Combat — separate from Active Buff Critical and Agility Stone Crit.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 free Critical(1) roll for this Combat. Before one eligible Martial Attack Roll or damaging Spell Casting Roll, spend one charge to designate that complete roll as Critical(1): natural 7s and 8s explode in the Attack/Casting Pool. Not a Damage Die bonus. A miss still spends the charge. One shared AoE roll costs one charge. Does not require Agility Stone Crit or Active Buff: Critical. Choose exactly one Critical source per roll.

passives.label: Maximization
passives.hint: Free Maximization uses each Combat for Damage or Healing Rolls — separate from Vitality Stone Maximization.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 free Maximization use shared between complete Damage Rolls and Healing Rolls this Combat. Declare immediately before an eligible Damage or Healing Roll (after Damage Negation for damage). Remaining d8s become artificial 8s — not natural 8s. A miss with no Damage Roll does not spend a use. One shared AoE Damage Roll costs one use. Does not require Vitality Stone Maximization. Choose exactly one Maximization source per roll.

passives.label: Special Aura
passives.hint: Choose one eligible diminishing Special(X). Inside your aura, it bites a little deeper.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — While a creature inside your 2 m aura is already affected by your chosen eligible Special(X), increase that Special by +1 step. This aura never applies, refreshes, extends, spreads, or triggers the Special.

passives.label: Enemy Evade Reduction
passives.hint: Your Martial Attack Rolls treat the targeted enemy as slightly easier to hit. Only your attacks; never changes their stored Evade.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Against your own eligible Martial Attack Rolls (including Martial AoE targets and Martial Reaction attacks that use a Martial Attack Roll), reduce the target's effective Evade by 2 (minimum 0). Does not modify stored Evade, create Expose, add Attack Dice, or change Spell Final TN.

passives.label: Spell Resistance Piercing
passives.hint: Your Spells ignore a slice of the target's Spell Resistance. Shared Casting Rolls still use per-target Final Spell TN.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — When you cast a Spell, ignore 2 of each target's Spell Resistance against that Spell (remaining SR = max(0, target SR − piercing)). Final Spell TN = Spell Base TN + remaining SR. Does not reduce Spell Base TN, stored SR, Evade, or SR against other casters. AoE Spells keep one Casting Roll with per-target Final TN.

passives.label: Special Amplification
passives.hint: Increases eligible numeric Special(X) values you successfully deliver with your own Martial/Spell Attacks. Distinct from Special Aura.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — When your qualifying successful Martial or Spell Attack delivers an eligible numeric Special(X), increase that Special by +1 after printed X, successful Raise Special Increase and Intellect Stone Special Boost, and before target Vulnerability, Special Negation and the 4 × MR application limit. Does not create Specials, amplify aura ticks, ongoing damage, ally/Summon attacks, binary Specials or hard control.

passives.label: Fortitude
passives.hint: Fortitude enlarges each normal Health Bar. It does not add bars, heal, or reopen Scarred bars. Cannot be slotted with Passive: Health.

passives.label: Regeneration
passives.hint: Restore Scarred Health Bars on yourself a few times per Tyhran Day (full HP each).
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Restore up to 2 Scarred Health Bars on yourself per Tyhran Day (full HP). Activate when able; does not spend Attack or Reaction. No turn-start healing.

passives.label: Phasing
passives.hint: Ignore a limited number of hits each combat.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — At the start of combat, gain 1 Phasing charge. Each charge lets you ignore one hit against you.

passives.label: Spell Resistance
passives.hint: Your body, mind, soul, or warding pattern rejects hostile spell structure.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Gain +5 Spell Resistance.

passives.label: Special Negation
passives.hint: Whenever an eligible hostile Special(X) would be applied, reduce its value by Special Negation before it is applied.
passives.mechanicsPreview: PL 4 — Reduce every incoming eligible hostile Special by 4.

passives.label: Invisibility
passives.hint: Always on: harder to locate/target (Perception TN + bonus), not higher Evade. Blocks Normal Awareness; higher ranks also block chosen Special Senses. AoE still hits.

passives.label: Parry
passives.hint: Spend a Parry pool to strip Attack Dice before they roll.

passives.label: Damage Negation
passives.hint: Spend a combat reserve of Damage Dice before damage is rolled.
